WebSocket 连接地址（Apifox「地址」栏粘贴）：
ws://127.0.0.1:50001/ws?userID=user_001&token=test_token&platformID=1&deviceID=apifox_device_001&sendResponse=true&isBackground=false&operationID=apifox-op-0001&compression=none&sdkType=normal&sdkVersion=1.0.0 

各指令报文（Apifox「消息」栏逐条粘贴，类型选 Text）：

--- 鉴权令牌获取（先执行，把 token 填到 {{token}}）---
POST http://127.0.0.1:18880/api/v1/auth/get_user_token
Body: {"platformID":1,"userID":"user_001"}

--- [msgIncr=1] 1001 WSGetNewestSeq 获取各会话最大/最小seq ---
{
  "reqIdentifier": 1001,
  "token": "test_token",
  "senderID": "user_001",
  "operationID": "apifox-1-3ave4f",
  "msgIncr": "1",
  "data": "Cgh1c2VyXzAwMQ=="
}
// data 解码后的 protobuf 字段:
// "(见脚本内构造逻辑)"

--- [msgIncr=2] 1002 WSPullMsgBySeqList 按seq范围拉取历史消息 ---
{
  "reqIdentifier": 1002,
  "token": "test_token",
  "senderID": "user_001",
  "operationID": "apifox-2-krjhaz",
  "msgIncr": "2",
  "data": "Cgh1c2VyXzAwMRIcChRzaV91c2VyXzAwMV91c2VyXzAwMhABGGQgFBINCgVzZ185MxABGGQgFA=="
}
// data 解码后的 protobuf 字段:
// "(见脚本内构造逻辑)"

--- [msgIncr=3] 1003 WSSendMsg 发送单聊文本消息 ---
{
  "reqIdentifier": 1003,
  "token": "test_token",
  "senderID": "user_001",
  "operationID": "apifox-3-ihrudv",
  "msgIncr": "3",
  "data": ""
}
// data 解码后的 protobuf 字段:
// {"sendID":"user_001","recvID":"user_002","clientMsgID":"client-msg-839441","senderPlatformID":1,"senderNickname":"测试用户001","sessionType":1,"msgFrom":100,"contentType":101,"content":"{\"text\":\"hello from apifox\",\"atUsers\":[]}","createTime":1792136839441}

--- [msgIncr=4] 1003 WSSendMsg 发送群聊@消息 ---
{
  "reqIdentifier": 1003,
  "token": "test_token",
  "senderID": "user_001",
  "operationID": "apifox-4-ch0hlc",
  "msgIncr": "4",
  "data": ""
}
// data 解码后的 protobuf 字段:
// {"sendID":"user_001","groupID":"93","clientMsgID":"client-msg-839443","senderPlatformID":1,"senderNickname":"测试用户001","sessionType":3,"msgFrom":100,"contentType":106,"content":"{\"text\":\"@user_002 请查
收\",\"atUsers\":[{\"atUserID\":\"user_002\",\"subTop\":\"user_002\"}]}","createTime":1792136839443}     

--- [msgIncr=5] 1005 WSPullMsg 按会话+seq列表精确拉取 ---
{
  "reqIdentifier": 1005,
  "token": "test_token",
  "senderID": "user_001",
  "operationID": "apifox-5-8d8yx4",
  "msgIncr": "5",
  "data": "Cgh1c2VyXzAwMRIcEhRzaV91c2VyXzAwMV91c2VyXzAwMhgBGAIYAw=="
}
// data 解码后的 protobuf 字段:
// {"userID":"user_001","conversations":[{"conversationID":"si_user_001_user_002","seqs":[1,2,3]}]}      

--- [msgIncr=6] 1006 WSGetConvMaxReadSeq 获取会话已读/最大seq ---
{
  "reqIdentifier": 1006,
  "token": "test_token",
  "senderID": "user_001",
  "operationID": "apifox-6-ggkt7e",
  "msgIncr": "6",
  "data": "Cgh1c2VyXzAwMRIUc2lfdXNlcl8wMDFfdXNlcl8wMDISBXNnXzkzGAE="
}
// data 解码后的 protobuf 字段:
// "(见脚本内构造逻辑)"

--- [msgIncr=7] 1007 WsPullConvLastMessage 拉取会话最后一条消息 ---
{
  "reqIdentifier": 1007,
  "token": "test_token",
  "senderID": "user_001",
  "operationID": "apifox-7-6byqp8",
  "msgIncr": "7",
  "data": "Cgh1c2VyXzAwMRIUc2lfdXNlcl8wMDFfdXNlcl8wMDISBXNnXzkz"
}
// data 解码后的 protobuf 字段:
// "(见脚本内构造逻辑)"

--- [msgIncr=8] 2005 WSSubUserOnlineStatus 订阅用户在线状态 ---
{
  "reqIdentifier": 2005,
  "token": "test_token",
  "senderID": "user_001",
  "operationID": "apifox-8-mraedf",
  "msgIncr": "8",
  "data": "Cgh1c2VyXzAwMgoNdGVzdF91c2VyXzAwMxINdGVzdF91c2VyXzAwNA=="
}
// data 解码后的 protobuf 字段:
// "(见脚本内构造逻辑)"

--- [msgIncr=9] 2004 WSSetBackgroundStatus 设置前后台状态（服务端暂未实现） ---
{
  "reqIdentifier": 2004,
  "token": "test_token",
  "senderID": "user_001",
  "operationID": "apifox-9-9pymwn",
  "msgIncr": "9",
  "data": "Cgh1c2VyXzAwMQ=="
}
// data 解码后的 protobuf 字段:
// "(见脚本内构造逻辑)"

--- [msgIncr=10] 2003 WSLogoutMsg 登出（服务端返回 not support 后关闭连接） ---
{
  "reqIdentifier": 2003,
  "token": "test_token",
  "senderID": "user_001",
  "operationID": "apifox-10-ya9akg",
  "msgIncr": "10",
  "data": ""
}

提示：msgIncr 每发一条可自增，用于把响应与请求对应起来；response 会原样带回 msgIncr。
